ns2:course.label: Design of Structural Systems
ns2:course.description: (CEE 365) The whole structural design process including definition of functional requirements, selection of structural scheme, formulation of design criteria, preliminary and computer-aided proportioning, and analysis of response, cost, and value. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Credit in either CEE 460 or CEE 461 with concurrent registration in the other.
